text:
anna: Heads-up: console shows p99 for /v1/chat up ~850ms at 00:12 UTC after we changed routing weights. p50 unchanged. anyone triaging? :eyes:
kai: saw it, only on the asia region slice. p95 moved a bit too. can you paste the panel query?
anna: panel uses per-endpoint rollups (tdigest_merge) grouped 1m. query in panel notes.
peter: two quick checks: (1) did we change rollup window or histogram buckets in infra? (2) did the routing change point to different pool with higher variance?
mira: infra PR yesterday changed rollup window from 20s -> 2m for cost smoothing. also a separate PR adjusted histogram bins (upper bound bumped from 700ms->768ms).
anna: thanks. deploy-bot: routing-weight-update deployed 2024-12-05T00:05Z by ci/cd. :white_check_mark:
kai: if rollup window increased and we rely on tdigest_merge, tails can inflate when bursts align across merged buckets. raw sample p99 might tell us if it's real.
peter: I pulled raw samples for asia node for the same window. raw p99 is steady ~420ms. UI p99 from tdigest_merge shows 850ms. that's a huge discrepancy.
mira: so likely aggregation artifact. we should avoid gating rollouts on displayed p99 until we confirm provenance. UX idea: show "percentile provenance" badge on hover (raw | tdigest | histogram-interp) so oncall can see whether it's merged or raw-derived.
anna: agreed. short term: annotate the dashboard with the routing deployment timestamp + rollup-window-change so triage knows they co-occur.
kai: I can run a replay that toggles 20s vs 2m merge windows and histogram bins. will post results in 15m.
peter: medium-term: add provenance metadata to rollup docs (e.g., rollup.vmeta: {source:tdigest, window:2m, buckets:...}) so console can show it without guessing. also add a safety check in rollout UI: if aggregation config changed within last hour, warn that percentile deltas may be aggregation artifacts.
mira: agreed. I'll open an infra revert PR to restore 20s window for high-cardinality endpoints and revert the histogram bin change until we validate.
anna: can we also add a quick UI note in the SLO page explaining merging semantics? folks keep assuming front-end percentiles == raw.
kai: replay done: reproduces p99 jump when merging at 2m vs 20s with tdigest_merge. raw-sample quantiles stable. attaching small snippet: 
```
# replay results (asia, synthetic burst)
merge_window=20s p99=430ms
merge_window=120s p99=860ms
raw-sample p99=420ms
```
peter: good verification. action items: (1) annotate dashboards + add manual note (mira); (2) infra revert PR (mira); (3) add rollup provenance metadata and console hover badge (peter + UX); (4) add replay test to CI that fails if merge-window change yields >20% UI p99 divergence from raw for endpoints marked "sensitive" (kai).
anna: thanks team. once revert is live we should watch SLO alerts for false positives and update the rollout checklist to include "aggregation config stable" gate.
mira: I'll tag the revert PR to this thread when ready.
deploy-bot: revert-rollup-window merged 2024-12-05T00:40Z by ci/cd. :white_check_mark:
anna: excellent. I'll follow up with SLO doc note and a small console hover mock for review. :thumbsup:
